authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FC-D9 check-status-set inventory from doctor-contract.v4. It does not author report bytes. It does not invent a D9 code. It does not invent an exit code. It does not assign the value half that DR-007 owns. It does not execute FC-D9. It does not close OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING at FC-D9 without inventing D9 codes, exit values, or report goldens. doctor v4 exactByteIntent requires one pinned check-status set per outcome class plus two named boundary cases. This catalog records those named sets. The derivation-value half remains boundedByDr007.

doctorV4.fcD9ExactByteIntent: One pinned check-status set per outcome class, paired with the report bytes the derivation rule produces from it - including the two boundary cases: a set containing BOTH a FAIL and an UNDETERMINED (must derive OC-2 with the incompleteness carried at report level), and a set containing only NOT-APPLICABLE and PASS (must derive OC-1).
doctorV4.boundedByDr007Verbatim: This class tests the STRUCTURE only. The value half - which exit each class maps to - cannot be fixtured until DR-007's successor closes, and the class says so rather than pinning a placeholder number. A fixture containing a numeric exit expectation would be this contract inventing what DR-007 owns.

g12v2.role: Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed. Not applied. Not withdrawn.

fcSchemaV1.role: Sibling named inventory. Awaiting independent review. Not applied. FC-D9 names derivation sets, not report-golden bytes.

whatIsAuthored: Named check-status-set inventory: one set per OC-1..OC-5 plus the two v4 boundary cases. No report bytes. No D9 code. No exit number.

namedSets.checkStatusSetNamed: every check success-bearing (PASS or NOT-APPLICABLE); no report-level residual limitation bearing on a check verdict
at least one FAIL, and the report is complete
at least one UNDETERMINED or CONSENT-REQUIRED, and no FAIL
no check results; invocation refused before any check runs
doctor itself failed to construct, write a required consent record, or emit the report
BOTH a FAIL and an UNDETERMINED
namedSets.verbatimFromV4: a set containing BOTH a FAIL and an UNDETERMINED (must derive OC-2 with the incompleteness carried at report level)
a set containing only NOT-APPLICABLE and PASS (must derive OC-1)

doesNot: Does not invent a D9 code.
Does not invent an exit number.
Does not assign the DR-007 value half.
Does not invent a section 7.1 recipe.
